Method of Attack: Posed as a legitimate QR code app on Google Play Store
Acted as a dropper app submitted without malicious code requesting minimal permissions
Fetched malicious payload update from external source via popup
Loaded as a new app requesting Accessibility Services permissions
Used Accessibility Services to view screen, grab screenshots exposing credentials, 2FA codes, SMS content
Performed background auto-granting of additional permissions without user interaction
String obfuscation and targeting of 400 banking, insurance, crypto wallet, and crypto exchange apps
Attack Vector: Google Play Store via trojanized QR code scanner apps
External update installation from non-trusted sources
Indicators of Compromise: Apps named 'QR Code & Barcode – Scanner' and 'QR Code Scanner: Add-On'
GitHub repositories by user 'feleanicusor' containing TeaBot samples
Positive user reviews on Play Store despite malicious behavior
Popup requesting update installation from external source
